mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, restrictive monetary policy increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profits, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls signals a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05) over 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime defined by RSAFS growth above 0.5% and HOUST above 1700 thousand units, overvaluation and profit-taking drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS growth > 0.5% and HOUST > 1700, or Rank IC for joint condition remains below 0.02 over 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 105.0 for two consecutive months, weakening manufacturing reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales decline for two consecutive months, weakening consumer demand reduces corporate revenue growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS growth < 0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market regime with unemployment below 5.0% and payroll growth above 0.5%, rising wage pressures and inflation expectations cause S&P 500 underperformance, generating negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 5.0 and PAYEMS growth > 0.5%, or Rank IC for joint condition falls below 0.02 over 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and rise in housing starts signals balanced economic growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates stable corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The joint effect of INDPRO decline and HOUST rise fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05) over 5-year rolling window.
